context_for_next_testing_agent: Both bugs confirmed fixed. Spinner CSS uses -webkit-inner-spin-button and -moz-appearance:textfield. Cursor fix works because onQtyChange/onRateChange no longer call renderRows() - they update only the amount cell in-place. Batch auto-fill triggers on item selection from dropdown combobox (not on qty typing). Item input id is comboInput0, qty id is qty0, rate id is rate0, batch id is batch0, amount id is amount0.
